##### Project general facts

Jumbo Collection Villas at Mira Golf Estates is a branded residential collection by MIRA Developments, created with the Italian furniture and interiors house Jumbo Collection. The homes follow a classical architectural language: arched entrances, tall windows, symmetrical façades, balustraded balconies and decorative cornices, framed by landscaped gardens. The collection comprises five-bedroom villas and five-bedroom mansions, each with a private pool and garden overlooking the fairways of the championship golf course. The mansions offer more expansive interiors for family life and entertaining, and a choice of larger private plots gives every mansion the scale of a personal estate.

Each home has its own swimming pool with a sun terrace, a private garden, a garage and dedicated staff accommodation, while a guest bedroom makes room for overnight visitors and the mansions add a home office. Beyond the plot, residents share the facilities of the wider community. For leisure there is the championship golf course with its clubhouse and dining terrace, lakes, restaurants, cafés and an event hall for large celebrations. Wellness is covered by a spa, fitness and sports facilities and a longevity hotel with a medical centre. Families have playgrounds, a kindergarten and an international school, and a shopping mall with a cinema handles daily convenience.

Every residence is delivered fully furnished, turnkey ready and fully serviced, with furniture, kitchens, wardrobes, lighting and appliances selected as a single complete interior concept. The interiors are designed by Jumbo Collection, whose furniture draws on Europe's historic residences through hand-carving, inlays and gilded finishes. Renders show panelled walls with pilasters, crystal chandeliers and gilded furniture in the living, dining and bedroom spaces. The package extends to kitchen appliances, textiles, home electronics, tableware and cutlery. The Mira Care warranty from the developer covers structural elements, core building systems, MEP installations, fixtures, lighting and paintwork, with separate cover for loose furniture.

##### Location description and benefits

Tashkent is the capital of Uzbekistan and the country's main centre for business, government, culture and transport. The city is growing outward from its historic core, and its north-eastern side is part of this expansion zone, where large public, sports and residential projects are taking shape. Landmarks in this direction include New Uzbekistan Park and Olympic City Stadium, while the New Tashkent district lies nearby. Central Tashkent and Tashkent International Airport are reachable by road, linking the area with the established city centre and with regional and international flights.

New Uzbekistan Park offers open green space for walks, cycling and family recreation, and Olympic City Stadium anchors a district built around sport and large public events. New Tashkent is a planned district combining residential, business and public areas. Central Tashkent brings together government offices, major business addresses, theatres, museums, traditional markets, restaurants and shopping streets, giving residents access to the cultural and commercial life of the capital. The airport serves as the main international gateway of the country, which is convenient for owners who travel frequently or divide their time between several cities.

Branded residences remain an emerging format in Uzbekistan, which gives fully furnished homes created with an international brand a distinct position in the Tashkent property market. The national economy, residential transaction volumes and international arrivals show steady growth, and the market is opening further to foreign buyers and visitors. Turnkey, fully serviced homes suit owners who want a ready residence in the capital for personal use, as well as buyers seeking a branded product in a developing market.
